run_custom_stable_diffusion_pipeline: run the CustomStableDiffusionPipeline to generate images from text prompts with optional known images
create_custom_stable_diffusion_pipeline: create a CustomStableDiffusionPipeline instance with VAE, text encoder, tokenizer, UNet, scheduler, and safety checker
encode_prompt: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the CLIP text encoder for classifier-free guidance
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale noise guidance tensors to fix overexposure using guidance_rescale factor
prepare_latents: prepare initial noise latents scaled by the scheduler's init_noise_sigma for the diffusion denoising loop
